title: IC-CSTR-Control-Benchmark: simulation code, controllers and data for anti-windup under actuator limits in an exothermic CSTR
description: Simulation code, PID controllers with seven anti-windup policies, campaign scripts, fixed random seeds, generated figures, literature-audit coding, and the CSV files behind every table and figure of the Journal of Process Control manuscript on anti-windup under amplitude and slew-rate limits (main text and supplementary material). See README.md for reproduction steps.
